title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Moderate thunderstorms are expected today

Highest Risk: SLGT (Southern Germany)

---Discussion---

Scattered thunderstorms are expected in the evening hours of today until late night hours.

Thunderstorms in Southern Germany will begin in the Far South West, and some could even enter Germany through Switzerland.

These Thunderstorms will have strong wind gusts and hail.

GNRL was issued into Czechia, due to strong winds from the thunderstorms.

Austria will also get thunderstorms in the South.
